entry_state: A shared typed representation supports several authoring methods and explicit adapters. Core evidence, accounting and uncertainty semantics remain AccDSL responsibilities; the mathematical chapter must now define historical compatibility and future simulation precisely.
exit_state: Historical answers remain joint, model-scoped families; future laws require declared kernels and justified measures. Bookkeeping conservation does not establish recognition validity, and compression or reported bounds must retain their exact mathematical meaning. The next step is to turn these definitions into construction procedures.
findings: The payable example distinguishes existence, creditor identity, row intersection and totals without inventing absence. Source theorems retain their stated relational assumptions.
The affine ambiguity, balanced-posting induction and total-variance derivation are reconstructible from the displayed assumptions. Fixed/floating weights remain illustrative.

Event generation, accounting and state transition remain distinct; conditional measurement cannot inspect realized future paths. No confirmed rendered defect in these six pages; source theorems are being reviewed as manuscript exposition, not freshly re-proved from their papers.
